title: Prove local federation forward ownership before sending the pair capability
outcome: Prevent a local port squatter from receiving a federation pair capability during SSH forward startup, using an ownership/proof boundary without a UI relay.
acceptance: The runtime pair key is never transmitted, over the link or to any local process, including one that occupies or replaces the selected forward port or relays proof responses; enrollment provisioning is separate. Peers authenticate over the SSH-owned byte stream as specified by design addendum A1 at the hash Architect2 concurs.

Tests discriminate a squatter and delayed cleanup from a genuine link, preserve one central-initiated OpenSSH session with loopback local/reverse forwards, and retain existing authentication/incarnation bounds.
Exact-input focused/full gate and independent review pair accompany the fix.

completion.summary: Delivered A1 mutual control-stream attestation and per-request MAC without runtime pair-key transmission; preserved authenticated native-binding and mailbox unknown-outcome semantics. Exact-input 116 focused tests and all five full-gate stages passed; independent acceptance passed 3/3.
